title: Tuning Deep Agents for Different Models

claims.text: Harness profiles vary prompts, tools, middleware, subagents, and skills per model/provider.
Model-specific profiles improved a tau2-bench subset by roughly 10-20 points in reported examples.
Codex benefits from prompt/tool conventions such as apply_patch, shell_command, and batching independent reads/searches.

hypotheses.text: Codex audit jobs produce more parseable and useful findings when given a Codex-specific read-only audit prompt.
Claude audit jobs improve when prompt requires tool result reflection and direct file/test verification.
